newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Chung Hwa Dev shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Chung Hwa Dev shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Hong Kong-based packager Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd was suspended on Thursday at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said.
Chung Hwa Development shares ended HK$0.10 up at HK$1.70 on Wednesday on volume of 125.48 million shares worth HK$208.59 million.
In December, the packager reported a 39.3 percent rise in interim profit to HK$17.52 million for the six months ended September 30, 1996, from HK$12.57 million in the same period a year earlier.
